text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since our three-year 
journey with Lucky Lilac reached its 
conclusion—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A complete victory for Lucky Lilac!! 
First place goes to Lucky Lilac!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In this year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup as 
well, the "Queen" Lucky Lilac remains 
unshakable!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your back-to-back 
victory! Could you tell us how you're 
feeling right now?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I am pleased to have demonstrated the 
fruits of my diligence.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I intend to defend my throne as "Queen" 
going forward. Please continue to look 
forward to my magnificent runs.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer B
text_block_list.text:
Will you be competing against Almond 
Eye-san in the Japan Cup again this year!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"If they enter the race, it'll naturally 
turn out that way."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer B
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, what are our exact 
chances of victory...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Of course I do. —For I am the 'Queen.'"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's Almond Eye-san, or any 
incredible Umamusume of the future—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I shall face each and every one as a 
"Queen," and defeat them equally.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“‘Her majesty as queen remains 
undiminished. Along with Almond Eye, one 
can feel her spirit refusing to yield to 
the younger generation just yet.’”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"‘What kind of running style will she 
enchant us with next? Will she be able to 
defend her throne moving forward?’—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Somehow, it feels a little like 
they're looking forward to a changing of 
the guard.
choice_data_list:
Still, you have no intention of backing 
down, right?

Still, you have no intention of backing 
down, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. After all, I'm the invincible 
"Queen"—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Because I will continue to be the star who 
brings color to the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's give it our all today too, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, first I'll go run the 1600m!
Yeah, I'm going to run 1600m first!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Why're YOU the one running?! It's the 
other way around!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Trainer, you really never 
miss a chance to play the fool, do you?"
choice_data_list: Because I'm your partner, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, let's keep working together 
on our comedy routines from now on, 
alright?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our journey as star comedic duo, boke and 
tsukkomi, continues on—
